request.style: English, punk rock, fast distorted power chords, driving bass, loud snare on every beat, a shouted male lead with gang vocals on the chorus, raw garage production, 160 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Passover in Jerusalem
Money changers at their tables
Cattle, sheep and doves for sale
In the courts of the temple

[Verse]
He made a whip out of cords
Drove them out with all their cattle
Scattered coins across the floor
Overturned their tables

[Chorus]
Get it out, get it out of here
Not a marketplace
My Father's house, my Father's house
Not a marketplace

[Verse]
His disciples remembered
What was written long ago
Zeal for your house will consume me
Zeal for your house will consume me

[Chorus]
Get it out, get it out of here
Not a marketplace
My Father's house, my Father's house
Not a marketplace
